caption: The drawing shows a wooden object resembling a shield or a decorative sign with upwardly curved sides and a prominent front panel. The object is primarily painted in a reddish brown color, with sections bordered in black and accented with a muted yellow-beige and green. The front panel features the text “Wm. Bliss” in bold uppercase letters near the top and the number “1840” in a similar style near the bottom, both in yellow-beige outlined in green. There are two prominent black dots, one on each side of the panel, and a roughly rectangular, outlined, empty space in the central area. The side edges of the object have some subtle blue-gray coloring and visible vertical ridges. The entire object is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Child's Sled
